bio.text: David G. Valadao was born in 1977 and raised in Hanford, California, and represents California's 22nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He was elected to the California State Assembly in 2010 and to Congress in 2012, representing the 21st District from 2013 to 2018, and returned to the House after the 2020 election.
His family operates dairies and farmland in Kings County, and he served on dairy industry organizations.
He serves on the House Appropriations Committee.
